sections.title: Missing network element
sections.description: Describe what is missing at the selected location. The report type is set by the chosen Access Hub action.

questions.text: What should reviewers know about this location?

en.#Describe what is missing at the selecte: Describe what is missing at the selected location. The report type is set by the chosen Access Hub action.
en.#What should reviewers know about this l: What should reviewers know about this location?

it.#Missing Network Element Report: Segnalazione di elemento di rete mancante
it.#Describe what is missing at the selecte: Descrivi cosa manca nel punto selezionato. Il tipo di segnalazione è determinato dall'azione scelta in Access Hub.
it.#What should reviewers know about this l: Cosa dovrebbero sapere i revisori su questo luogo?

fr.#Describe what is missing at the selecte: Décrivez ce qui manque à l’endroit sélectionné. Le type de signalement est défini par l’action Access Hub choisie.
fr.#What should reviewers know about this l: Que devraient savoir les personnes chargées de la vérification à propos de cet endroit ?

de.#Describe what is missing at the selecte: Beschreiben Sie, was am ausgewählten Ort fehlt. Der Meldungstyp wird durch die gewählte Access Hub-Aktion festgelegt.
de.#What should reviewers know about this l: Was sollten die Prüfenden über diesen Ort wissen?

tr.#Describe what is missing at the selecte: Seçilen konumda neyin eksik olduğunu açıklayın. Bildirim türü, seçilen Access Hub eylemine göre belirlenir.
tr.#What should reviewers know about this l: İnceleyenler bu konum hakkında ne bilmeli?

fa.#Describe what is missing at the selecte: توضیح دهید در مکان انتخاب‌شده چه چیزی وجود ندارد. نوع گزارش بر اساس اقدام انتخاب‌شده در Access Hub تعیین می‌شود.
fa.#What should reviewers know about this l: بازبینان باید درباره این مکان چه بدانند؟

hu.#Describe what is missing at the selecte: Írja le, mi hiányzik a kiválasztott helyen. A bejelentés típusát a kiválasztott Access Hub művelet határozza meg.
hu.#What should reviewers know about this l: Mit érdemes tudniuk az ellenőrzőknek erről a helyről?

ar.#Describe what is missing at the selecte: صِف ما هو مفقود في الموقع المحدد. يُحدَّد نوع البلاغ بحسب إجراء Access Hub الذي تم اختياره.
ar.#What should reviewers know about this l: ما الذي ينبغي أن يعرفه المراجعون عن هذا الموقع؟
